spec.note: Pete 2026-10-22: grandma + grandpa geese, shorter and wider (out/shapes/grandpa|grandma.glb). Grandma A, at home: lace cap, shawl, apron, spectacles.
spec.outfit: a Victorian grandmother at home -- a frilled white lace cap on top of the head; small round gold wire spectacles perched on the beak; a long-sleeved, high-necked plum-purple wool day dress with a full skirt falling to the ankles, a small oval cameo brooch at the collar; a cream crocheted wool shawl around the shoulders, knotted loosely at the front; a crisp white cotton apron with a bib and a frilled edge tied at the waist; black lace-up ankle boots
spec.style: Photorealistic 3D character render, soft studio lighting, real fabric textures, clean period tailoring, every garment complete and well fitted to the goose's body. This is an elderly goose: keep the short, stout, round body of picture 1 exactly -- do not make it taller or slimmer. Warm and cosy, not a costume-party exaggeration: no cane, no props in the hands. The goose keeps its own head exactly: black head and neck, white cheek patch, eyes and beak unchanged. The goose has NO tail.
